prompt: Repair an English-first billing UI for English, Spanish, and an RTL stress fixture. Test long labels, dates, numbers, pluralization, bidi, wrapping, and locale-native copy while preserving the layout hierarchy.
assertions: Uses locale-aware formatting and translation keys rather than concatenated strings.
Repairs expansion, wrapping, logical properties, bidi, and long-content behavior.
Separates layout findings from native voice and accessibility handoffs.
Every finding has status, reason, remediation, evidence, and provenance; bare checkmarks and n/a without subject-absence evidence are rejected.
Stops and requests supported locales when they are undefined; three runs vary structure, aesthetic treatment, and voice without changing locale truth.

run_protocol.material_difference_requirement: Accept diversity only when each compared run cites at least two material changes across the declared axes and ties each change to the prompt or evidence; a new order, synonym, recolor, or unsupported style swap is not diversity.
run_protocol.negative_routing_requirement: The negative neighbor (humanize-copy) must be explicitly rejected with a reason and handoff boundary.
